page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; text block of running prose in the centre; a woodcut emblem (coat of arms) below the text; no marginal notes in the text area. Faint show-through at the left edge is not transcribed.

main_text.p: na laudata sunt, huc translata. Sic habes editionis hujus & inscriptionis caussas, quas judicio tuo spero satisfacturas. Bené vale & vive in Christo, qui prior nos dilexit. Anno M D C I. Mense Augusto.

page.notes: The first line is a line fragment continuing from the previous page. The woodcut emblem below the text is a printer's ornament (coat of arms with a crowned lion's head and foliage) and is not transcribed as text. Long s has been rendered as plain s; "caussas" and "spero" are as printed in the scan. The line "Sic habes..." etc. is set as ordinary running text and has been joined into one paragraph, since no indent marks a new paragraph within it.
